meta.methodology: Evaluated per use case (Godot 4.x compat, stability, maintenance, docs, coexistence, reusability, 2D fit, programmatic control, no forced rebuild, AI-agent practicality, video-pipeline license safety). Sources: official Godot docs, Asset Library, official GitHub repos via GitHub API, reputable third parties (kenney.nl).

candidates.name: Phantom Camera
candidates.what_it_does: Cinemachine-style Camera2D layering: PhantomCameraHost + PhantomCamera2D nodes; follow modes (Glued/Simple/Group/Path/Framed), zoom, limits, tweened transitions, noise shake.
candidates.why_it_helps: Project has no camera at all; videos need framing, follow, impact shake, zoom, shot cuts - all programmatically controllable.
candidates.integration: Additive addon + nodes in video scenes; director switches shots via priority/make_current. Leon scenes untouched.
candidates.risks: Adds plugin autoload (PhantomCameraManager); pin stable release (upstream 4.7 quirk pending engine PR); shake/damping not frame-deterministic - use Glued + tweens for determinism.

candidates.name: GdUnit4
candidates.godot_version: 4.x (v6.2.1 targets 4.5+; verify 4.7 row in compat table at install)
candidates.what_it_does: Embedded GDScript/C# unit + scene test framework: fluent asserts, scene runner, signal awaiting, mocks/spies, orphan-node detection, HTML/JUnit reports, headless CLI runner.
candidates.why_it_helps: Converts ad-hoc verify_*.gd scripts into repeatable headless regression tests; makes AI-agent edits verifiable deterministically.
candidates.integration: Addon + new tests/ directory; existing verify scripts unaffected; run headless before renders.
candidates.risks: Editor UI weight (CLI-only usage fine); mocking learning curve; verify 4.7 compat row at install.

candidates.name: Kenney Particle Pack (+ built-in GPUParticles2D/CPUParticles2D)
candidates.godot_version: engine-independent textures; particle nodes are built-in
candidates.what_it_does: 80 CC0 smoke/glow/spark/flash sprites used as textures for reusable built-in particle emitter scenes (hit impacts, dust, flashes, smoke).
candidates.why_it_helps: Project has zero VFX today; reusable emitters > one-off effect packs.
candidates.integration: assets/vfx/kenney_particles/ + scenes/vfx/*.tscn emitters triggered from attack_impact / state_changed via VFXAttachmentPoints markers.
candidates.risks: GL Compatibility limits advanced particle materials (use standard blend modes); prefer CPUParticles2D for deterministic capture.

candidates.name: Dialogic 2
candidates.what_it_does: Timeline-based event editor and runtime: characters, dialogue, signals, waits, conditions, custom events; timelines are reusable .dtl resources.
candidates.why_it_helps: Video scripts as sequences of actions; timeline events can drive character.wants_* flags, AudioManager.trigger_event(), and camera shot switches through a thin adapter.
candidates.integration: Authoring layer only; state machine and audio remain authoritative. Defer until a video is dialogue-driven.
candidates.risks: Large editor-heavy plugin; dialogue-flow oriented, not frame-precise choreography.

alternatives_considered.name: Dialogue Manager 4 (Nathan Hoad)
alternatives_considered.note: Equally viable; install only ONE dialogue tool if needed.

candidates.name: Godot State Charts
candidates.what_it_does: UML state-chart nodes (StateChart, Atomic/Compound/Parallel states, signal/property/timeout transitions) with an in-editor transition debugger.
candidates.why_it_helps: Only if future characters outgrow enum state machines; visual state debugging.
candidates.integration: Would wrap/replace character_controller.gd change_state() - a rewrite of working code.
candidates.risks: Conflicts with do-not-redesign-Leon rule; current enum SM with deterministic guards is simpler.

candidates.name: gdtoolkit (gdformat/gdlint/gdparse)
candidates.what_it_does: GDScript formatter (gdformat), linter (gdlint), and syntax validator (gdparse) as CLI tools.
candidates.why_it_helps: Keeps 9k+ lines of scripts consistent across AI-agent edits; fast syntax validation without opening the editor.
candidates.integration: pip install gdtoolkit; run pre-commit/pre-render. One-time repo-wide format on a dedicated commit.
candidates.risks: Whole-repo gdformat creates a large one-time diff.

candidates.name: Godot built-in 2D skeleton IK modifiers (LookAtModifier2D, TwoBoneIKModifier2D)
candidates.godot_version: shipped in Godot 4.4+ (2D skeleton modifier system); present in 4.7 (confirm exact class availability in editor)
candidates.what_it_does: Runtime 2D bone modifiers on Skeleton2D: look-at rotation targeting (head/eyes/aim) and two-bone IK chain solving.
candidates.why_it_helps: Head look-at and hand-aim polish on the existing FK cutout rig without rebuilding it; no plugin dependency.
candidates.integration: Modifier nodes as children of relevant Bone2D chains; gated per state via character_controller signals; authored FK animations stay authoritative.
candidates.risks: Modifiers run every frame - gate per state to avoid fighting keyframes; confirm class availability in the 4.7 editor before designing around them.
